_comment: semantic-analysis and constraint-monitor were removed as MCP servers: their 23 tool schemas cost ~14 KB (~3,540 tokens) in every context window, of every session, subagent and fork, for tools that are only ever invoked deliberately. They are now the `semantic` and `constraints` CLIs (bin/), with the /semantic and /constraints skills. Both packages keep running — semantic-analysis serves :3848, which bin/semantic calls and the dashboard's workflow view reads. graphify stays an MCP server: its traversal tools are the one set worth reaching for mid-reasoning.
